title: MV Help with making an auto-battle party member that attacks other party members with magic skills. ( RPG Maker MV)

posts.author: faek9
posts.body:
Hi, I am new here and would like to ask for help for a battle with a mechanic that I am having trouble implementing in the exact way I want.
It involves a sort of magician/trickster boss-character that uses a skill that summons a party member in your crew, but the catch is that they cannot be controlled and are evil and will attack you, a thing to catch you off-guard, and add some extra chaos amidst the battle. The answer to this problem is to use the magic counter-attack status effect in order to deflect attacks back and defeat this evil party member.
The problem is that I need the party member to be able to DO magic attacks on other party members, but all they do is attack regular style. I made a status effect that makes it where they attack allies, as otherwise they attack the enemy like a normal party member, but because of the weird way status effects work in RPG Maker, the actor cannot perform magic attacks and just hits the other actors.
I then got rid of the status effect and tried to make it where their only form of attack is an ally damaging magic skill, but again, they default to just attacking the enemy.
Is there a plugin that lets me have total control over an auto-battle actor's behavior (who they attack and such) and what skills they use?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Can't you have that guy just appear as a regular enemy mid battle? If you want it to be a party member, you can use Yanfly action sequences to give them skills that hit and damage your own members. Yanfly also has actor auto battle ai plugin.
